# Dima Durah

> Fractional marketing and growth lead. I build, scale and sell AI products, combining AI, product strategy, and open-source principles to turn ideas into self-sustaining growth engines. Pronounced dee-mah, she/her.

Roles: GTM Architect; Product Growth Marketing; Strategic Growth & Partnerships; Open source contributor; AI Product Marketing.
Ideal projects: Growth & Partnerships; Product Marketing & GTM; AI Product Management.

## Featured work
- [Living Assets Inc.](https://mmc.vc/research/ai-discoverability-how-can-i-get-chatgpt-to-recommend-my-brand/): built and led product and growth strategy for an AI discovery platform helping publishers optimize visibility across agentic search
- [Veil by claai](https://mmc.vc/research/ethical-ai-moving-from-napster-to-spotify-era/): co-created an ML tool that perturbs images to prevent unauthorized AI training
- [Spectral](https://techcrunch.com/2022/08/24/spectral-raises-23m-to-help-create-web3-credit-scores/): Head of Product Marketing for an on-chain credit scoring protocol
- [OwnID (pre-exit)](https://www.ownid.com/): shaped messaging, GTM architecture and sales outreach strategy while it was part of SAP, before its spin-out
- [SAP Early Stage VC Fund](https://news.sap.com/2023/12/ai-powered-startup-partner-solutions-sap-io/): fund design, storytelling and accelerator outreach for underrepresented B2B SaaS founders
- [Momstacles](https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/momstacles/list?title_no=46615): webcomic about millennial motherhood
- [Aviation Blockchain Challenge](https://lh-innovationhub.de/projekt/aviationblockchainchallenge/): co-led program design and venture selection for Lufthansa and SAP
